task: Improve the Brain App so the assistant can coordinate tasks end-to-end with the least user effort. Inspect the existing repository files and produce a concrete implementation plan for the next safe bridge between the browser-local task queue and GitHub Actions relay. Prefer free GitHub-native automation; do not add paid services, do not put tokens/API keys in static browser code, and do not publish task prompts or worker responses publicly. Identify what can be implemented now without new user clicks, then provide a precise file-by-file patch proposal. Do not claim changes were made unless you actually make them.
prior_packet: Repository: Astridrosexxx84/Astridrose-automation-. Current implementation: static GitHub Pages dashboard stores tasks in browser localStorage; assistant can trigger a relay by committing brain-app/relay-request.json; GitHub Actions runs Groq → Gemini → OpenRouter free route, produces brain-relay-packet.json artifact and publishes metadata-only brain-app/relay-status.json. Dashboard has a manual Import relay result control. No browser-side privileged token is allowed. We need remove as much of the queue/relay disconnect as safely possible and maintain $0-only constraints. Evaluate secure choices including a repo-backed task queue, privacy boundary, automatic result ingestion, duplicate processing, artifact retention, and concurrency. Keep answer implementation-focused.
